lines.text: در دو شخص مشتغل در امر واحد متساوي نبود و همچنین و از او نباید سخنی کسیکه گوید که اگر دلایل
lines.en: in two persons engaged in a single matter it would not be equal. And likewise, one should not [heed] the word of someone who says that if the indicators

lines.text: اصلي و تحویل شخصي مسعود است سعادت بی اختیار تحصیل حاصل باشد و اگر دلایل اصلي
lines.en: of the radix and the personal revolution are fortunate, happiness will be attained without election; and if the indicators of the radix

lines.text: و تحویل شخصي منحوس است سعادت اختیار مانع بیحاصل اما معرفت اشغالي که مستحق
lines.en: and the personal revolution are unfortunate, the happiness of the election is a hindrance [and] fruitless. But the knowledge of the occupations that deserve

lines.text: اختیار نباشد اینست که میفرماید که هر شغلی که هر روز یا هر هفته چند بار محتاج الیه باشد
lines.en: an election is not this, which he states: that any occupation that is needed several times every day or every week,

lines.text: در انشغل حاجت اختیار نیست زیرا که هر که محتاج الیه که هر روز یا هر هفته باشد عادت
lines.en: in that occupation there is no need for an election, because whatever is needed every day or every week becomes a habit

lines.text: بر انجاري شود و امور عادي قایم مقام امور طبيعي باشد كما يقال العادة طبيعت
lines.en: for it to be carried out, and habitual matters stand in the place of natural matters, as it is said: 'Habit is a second nature'

lines.text: ثانيه الانسان وظاهر است که در امور طبيعي اختیار را مدخل نیست اما در اشغال دیگر
lines.en: to man. And it is obvious that in natural matters election has no entry. But in other occupations

lines.text: که هر آئینه مستحق و محتاج اختیار است وقتي اختیار باید کرد که قمر و بیت قمر و صاحب
lines.en: that are certainly deserving and in need of an election, an election must be made when the Moon, the house of the Moon, and the lord

lines.text: بیت قمر و كوكبي شغل مفروض منسوب باو باشد مثل انکه زراعت منسوب بزحلست و دعوي
lines.en: of the house of the Moon, and the planet to which the assumed occupation is attributed—for example, agriculture is attributed to Saturn, and a legal claim

lines.text: شرعیه منسوب بمشتري و على هذا و طالع وقت اختیار و صاحب طالع و خانه منسوب اليه شغل
lines.en: is attributed to Jupiter, and so on—and the ascendant of the time of the election, and the lord of the ascendant, and the house to which the occupation is attributed—

lines.text: مثل انکه خانه نهم منسوب الیه سفر است و خانه چهارم منسوب الیه زراعت است و على هذا
lines.en: for example, the ninth house is attributed to travel, and the fourth house is attributed to agriculture, and so on—

lines.text: و صاحب اینخانه و اینها همه یا بيشتري الحال باشند و ضروریات اختیار در وسعت
lines.en: and the lord of this house, and all of these, or most of them, are in good condition. And the necessities of election in the breadth

lines.text: وقت که در مقدمه موعود بود همین هشت چیز است و بعضي مصنف گفته اند موافق انچه امام
lines.en: of time, which was promised in the introduction, are these same eight things. And some authors have said, in accordance with what the Imam

lines.text: در اختیارات علائیه آورده و محقق طوسي در سلک نظم کشیده بیت اختیار هر چه داري
lines.en: brought in the Ikhtiyarat-i 'Ala'i, and the investigator Tusi strung in the thread of poetry: [Poem] Whatever election you have,

lines.text: هفت چیز آور بجاي : تا بود کار تو نیکو و بین همي دان مغرض : حال مه سعود باید حال برج
lines.en: bring seven things into place : so that your work may be good, and see, always know the purpose : the condition of the Moon must be fortunate, the condition of the sign

lines.text: و صاحبش : حال طالع صاحبش بيت الغرض صاحب غرض : و رعایت حال قمر و متعلقات او در
lines.en: and its lord : the condition of the ascendant, its lord, the house of the purpose, the lord of the purpose : And observing the condition of the Moon and its attachments in

lines.text: این امر دون کواکب دیگر بنابر انست که قمر اقربست بارض از باقي اجرام پس تأثیر او در
lines.en: this matter, rather than other planets, is based on the fact that the Moon is closest to the earth of the remaining bodies, so its influence in

lines.text: عالم سفلي اظهر باشد و ايضا اسرع سایر سیارات است پس نسبت او بتغیرات عالم عناصر
lines.en: the lower world is more apparent. And also it is the fastest of the other planets, so its relation to the changes of the world of elements

lines.text: اکثر باشد و ايضا اسرع سایر سیارات است و نیز قمر از غایت سرعت انوار کواکب دیگر را
lines.en: is the most. And also it is the fastest of the other planets, and also the Moon, due to the extreme speed, [transmits] the lights of the other planets

summary.headline: Conditions for Astrological Election
summary.text: Discussion of judicial astrology elections, rejecting reliance on fortunate radix and personal-revolution indicators alone and identifying occupations that require election. It lists the eight conditions for a favorable election, cites the Ikhtiyarat-i ʿAlaʾi and Tusi’s verse on seven essentials, and explains the Moon’s special importance because of its proximity and speed.
